text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated gateway 502/504 + runtime 5xx observed for inference-gateway in us-east-1 beginning ~12:00 UTC. Automated thresholds tripped (error-rate + gateway timeouts). Paging @oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: acknowledged. jumping in. what services/users impacted?

jules (infra): i'm looking at cache telemetry — prefix-cache eviction-rate spiked from ~1% to 48% over 4m. We're also seeing crc-mismatch errors during reads and repeated 'evict-iterator overflow' traces from cache-shard-2.

priya (sre): putting up a quick chart: prefix-cache miss% = 55% at peak, kv-p99 latency = 1.2s, gateway 5xx rate x4 baseline. A subset of dedicated pools are failing requests with gateway timeouts.

jules (infra): tail from runtime/gateway logs:

```
2026-03-14T12:01:57Z cache ERROR prefix_cache.go:248 read failed: crc-mismatch key=pre-0xf3a2
2026-03-14T12:01:58Z cache WARN eviction: iterator overflow on shard=2
2026-03-14T12:01:59Z gateway ERROR handler.go:412 upstream error: kv_read_timeout (latency=1187ms) route=/v1/chat
2026-03-14T12:02:01Z runtime ERROR applyKV: checksum-verify-failed key=pre-0x9c11
```

jules (infra): note: a canary rollout for `prefix-cache-v3` completed ~9m before the spike. possibility: corrupt index + aggressive eviction policy combined.

oncall-ryan: immediate mitigation goals: stop the cascade (timeouts -> gateways -> client retries), protect no-regress customers, collect forensic snapshot. Proposed steps: 1) shift affected pools to no-cache routing, 2) mark cache shards read-only and remove from LB, 3) increase gateway upstream timeouts briefly, 4) start scrub/repair job on shards. Any objections?

priya (sre): +1. Also enable cache circuit-breaker on gateway so cache latency doesn't cause gateway 5xx. Will coordinate deploy.

jules (infra): executing step 1: `router apply --pool dedicated-use1 --policy route_without_cache --reason "incident 1765443210"`

infra-bot: router apply accepted. Routes updated for pools: dedicated-use1-a,b.

jules (infra): removing shards 2 and 3 from cache rotation: `kvctl shard drain --shard 2,3 --mode graceful`

infra-bot: shard drain requested. replicas will report draining status.

jules (infra): toggling cache write flag to false: `kvctl feature toggle prefix_cache_writes=false --env prod --region us-east-1`

infra-bot: feature toggle applied.

priya (sre): deploying gateway circuit-breaker: `deploy gateway --circuit-breaker cache_kv_p95=500ms --region us-east-1`

infra-bot: deploy triggered to 3 gateway nodes.

customer-ops: initial impact report: TEN-210 and TEN-403 reporting elevated errors; both on dedicated pools in us-east-1. CS alerted for high-touch accounts.

jules (infra): starting scrub job (non-blocking): `kv-scrub --shard 2 --verify-checksums --repair --max-parallel 8`

```
2026-03-14T12:06:42Z kv-scrub INFO shard=2 repaired=87 corrupt=87 scanned=1024
2026-03-14T12:07:10Z kv-scrub INFO shard=3 repaired=0 corrupt=0 scanned=1000
```

priya (sre): monitoring shows request errors drop ~70% within 2m of route switch + circuit-breaker. Gateway timeouts reduced, p95 latency improving. Good sign.

jules (infra): scrub completed on shard-2, found ~87 corrupted keys, repaired by restore-from-backup. Will continue verification for shard-0/1/4.

oncall-ryan: good. next steps: keep traffic on no-cache path for 30m soak, complete full scrub, run a controlled canary redeploy of prefix-cache-v2 (previous stable) with gating. Also take cluster snapshots for analysis.

priya (sre): creating incident ticket INC-1765443210 and adding timeline. Handoff to me in 20m unless we see a regression.

jules (infra): snapshot saved: s3://redwood-backups/ccsnap/1765443210-pre-repair (retention 21d). Starting full-consistency-check: `kv-check --all-shards --consistency-mode full`

customer-ops: CS: TEN-210 reports partial recovery, TEN-403 now OK. We'll update customers that mitigations are in place and a postmortem will follow.

priya (sre): status update: severity lowered to P3 at 12:12 UTC. Error-rate near baseline for most routes; dedicated pools on no-cache path stable.

jules (infra): findings so far: crc mismatches concentrated on shard-2; likely root cause vector: bad index write during prefix-cache-v3 rollout combined with aggressive eviction threshold. We'll prepare a post-incident checklist: tighter rollout gates, checksum-on-write, safer eviction hysteresis, and an automatic cache-circuit-breaker.

oncall-ryan: thanks team. leaving channel, will be reachable if needed.

priya (sre): I have the channel. Actions assigned:
- infra/jules: full scrub + PR for checksum-on-write and rollout gating (owner: jules)
- runtime: implement gateway-level cache circuit-breaker and exponential backoff on KV timeouts (owner: runtime-team)
- deploy: add rollback triggers for cache config rollouts (owner: deploy-team)

jules (infra): starting PR branch and test harness today. Will include reproduction steps for corrupt index scenario.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 12:23 UTC 47 traffic for affected tenants restored to normal. Postmortem required.

priya (sre): posting postmortem invite for 24 hours. Please attach logs and scrub output to INC-1765443210. :white_check_mark:

customer-ops: will follow up with affected customers after final validation.

jules (infra): closing with note: keep cache shards in read-only mode until checksum-on-write is merged and canary passes.

priya (sre): thanks all.
